name: markdown-language-plumbing
body: Add an `md` language id and wire it into the scanner plumbing: the auto-detection candidate list (matching .md/.markdown and not tripping on generated/dependency directories), the `lang_switch` control record that drives per-record code-type classification and FQN rendering, the `--id-prefix` namespacing entry so merged multi-language scans keep opaque ids unique, and the runtime frontend-command resolution for the md frontend. AC: a markdown-only repo auto-detects md; a mixed repo scans md alongside its code languages into one graph; the md stream carries its own id prefix and lang_switch record.
